summary: Frontend-only test of BulletinConfigModal Phase 3 (Visual Editor wiring) + Phase 4 (advanced calculation rules) + live preview. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. Login admin → /notes → Master Digital Marketing 2026 → 'Gérer les notes' → Configuration tab opens the BulletinConfigModal hub. (1) HUB + LIVE PREVIEW: data-testid='config-hub' (count=1) renders the 5 ConfigCards (config-card-rules / structure / design / signatures / templates, each count=1). At lg+ viewport (tested at 1920x1080) the new data-testid='bulletin-live-preview' is present and visible to the right of the cards in a sticky column. The mini bulletin contains: a paper-effect header (Établissement / period name 'SEMESTRE 1' / 'RELEVÉ DE NOTES'), an identity row (NOM/FORMATION), a colour-themed table with 5 columns (MATIERE/COEF/MOY/PROMO/APPREC) and 3 mock rows (MARKETING/COMMUNICATION/ANGLAIS) + a footer 'Moyenne' row showing 13.83 in accent colour, and 3 bottom boxes ASSIDUITE / APPRECIATION / DIRECTEUR (all four texts confirmed in inner_text). The italic note 'Mise à jour en temps réel selon vos modifications' is rendered below. (2) PHASE 3 — visual editor wiring: button data-testid='open-visual-editor-btn' has label exactly 'Ouvrir l'éditeur' (no longer 'Bientôt disponible') and is_disabled=False. Clicking it opens data-testid='visual-editor-section' (count=1). DialogTitle (config-modal-title) contains 'Éditeur visuel du bulletin' ✓. Back button (config-back-btn) is present and returns to the hub (config-hub count=1 again). Footer Save button (bulletin-config-save) is rendered & visible inside the visual-editor section per spec (Footer condition includes 'visual-editor'). The lazy-loaded BulletinLayoutEditor mounts cleanly: screenshot shows the full editor UI (Mise en page complète / Tableau de notes / Aperçu live tabs; INSÉRER toolbar with Texte/Variable/Logo/Image/Trait/Forme/QRCode; EN-TÊTE / CORPS DU BULLETIN / PIED DE PAGE zones; right-side ASTUCES + VARIABLES panel with {nom_complet}, {prenom}, {nom}, {date_naissance}, etc.). No runtime / pageerror during the lazy load (only the pre-existing X-Frame-Options meta warning + ResizeObserver loop notice + the known compute-bulletin CORS/404 — explicitly ignored per request). (3) PHASE 4 — Règles avancées: in Règles de calculs > Calculs sub-tab, data-testid='advanced-rules-section' is present (count=1) with all required controls: rule-ue-eliminatoire (row) + rule-ue-eliminatoire-switch (Switch), rule-bloc-validation (row) + rule-bloc-validation-switch (Switch), rule-points-threshold (Input, default value '220' as required), rule-decision-method (Select trigger). Opening the Select reveals all 3 options: 'Sur la moyenne (≥ seuil)', 'Sur le total des points', 'Moyenne + UE/blocs validés'. Toggling both switches and changing the threshold from 220 to 250 caused NO runtime error and the Input value updated correctly. (4) NON-REGRESSION: iter 61 flows still work — hub ↔ rules navigation, back button, DialogTitle 'Configuration' on hub. Save flow itself (toast 'Configuration enregistrée') was already validated in iter 61 and was not re-tested in iter 62 because pressing Escape to close the Select dropdown also closed the shadcn Dialog (standard behaviour) — this is a TEST artefact, not a product bug; the save mutation logic was unchanged for this iteration.
action_items: NONE BLOCKING. Phase 3 (Visual Editor wiring) + Phase 4 lite (advanced rules UI) + Live preview all validated end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: BulletinConfigModal.tsx is now 1136 lines (was 1005 in iter 61, +131 lines) — well above the 700-line healthy threshold. Highly recommend splitting into per-section sub-components (HubSection / RulesSection with AdvancedRulesPanel / StructureSection / DesignSection / SignaturesSection / TemplatesSection / VisualEditorSection) before the next major addition. The advanced-rules-section block is a self-contained 57-line panel that would extract cleanly.

BulletinPreview.tsx (144 lines) is well-scoped, props are clean (config / periodName / formationTitle), uses CSS aspect-ratio for paper effect — good. It correctly reads design_config.primary_color / accent_color / font_family / table_header_bg / table_header_color, layout_config.table_columns and signatories.length to drive the visual. Mock data is hard-coded (MARKETING / COMMUNICATION / ANGLAIS rows) — that is acceptable for a preview, but consider exposing a 'sampleStudentName' / 'sampleRows' prop later if E1 wants to preview real subject names from the formation. Non-blocking.

Section 'visual-editor' is added to the ActiveSection union via `'visual-editor'` AND a runtime cast `setSection('visual-editor' as any)` on the button onClick. The `as any` cast indicates the tsconfig didn't pick up the new union member at the call site — works but suggests the type was widened only in declaration. Cleaner: add the value to the union type literal AND remove the cast at the call site (line 259) to keep TS strict.

Phase 4 advanced-rules block stores its 4 new fields under `cfg.calculation_rules` with `as any` casts (lines 548-549, 560-561, 571-572, 581-582) because ResolvedBulletinConfig['calculation_rules'] does not yet declare ue_eliminatoire / bloc_validation_required / total_points_threshold / decision_method. Recommend extending the type definition in /app/src/types/bulletinConfig.ts so these casts can be removed and the new fields type-checked. Non-blocking but improves maintainability.

Footer save section now correctly includes 'visual-editor' in the visibility condition (line 1026: `section === 'rules' || ... || section === 'visual-editor'`). Save button is correctly hidden on hub & templates per spec. ✓

BulletinLayoutEditor (1599 lines, lazy-loaded via React.lazy + Suspense fallback) — confirmed it mounts without errors in the section. The wiring of headerElements / bodyElements / footerElements / tableColumns / tableStyle reads from cfg.layout_config.layout_elements and table_columns_v2 / table_style_v2 — all using `as any` again (lines 288-303). Same recommendation: extend layout_config type to include layout_elements / table_columns_v2 / table_style_v2 / signatories_v2.

Note (out-of-scope per request): the calculation_rules new flags (ue_eliminatoire / bloc_validation_required / total_points_threshold / decision_method) are persisted via saveMutation but NOT YET consumed by SimpleBulletinTemplate / CombinedBulletinRenderer — the decision logic still uses the legacy mention/decision fields. This is the next iteration as documented in the agent_to_agent_context_note.
Pre-existing (non-regression, ignored): Supabase Edge Function compute-bulletin still returns CORS/404 — fallback client-side aggregation works.

Pre-existing console warning: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications (medium severity, captured by /app/src/utils/monitoring.ts). Likely from the BulletinLayoutEditor's resize observer on element-positioning. Non-blocking, common in editor-style UIs.
